title: Ralph Mote Larsson says he knows nothing about UFOs and would publicize it if he did
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Ralph Mote Larsson says he knows nothing about UFOs and would publicize it if he did, about 2020s at Jesse Michels interview, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: guy Ralph Moat Lararsson who we spoke about. I think you know him and um you know I interviewed you and I interview a bunch of people who I respect from government circles and they know nothing about the UFO stuff

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with a former director of the NSA, the US agency that intercepts communications, mentions a man named Ralph Mote Larsson whom he has interviewed. Michels says Larsson and other people he respects from government circles tell him they know nothing about UFOs, and the story's framing is that Larsson says he would make it public if he did.
